description.en: Open a local shell in the project folder, outside agent approvals; its output isn't sent to the model. When off, the panel is hidden and running terminals are closed. Shipped with Pi Desktop.
description.zh-CN: 在项目目录里打开本机 shell，不经过 Agent 审批，输出也不会发送给模型。关闭后面板隐藏，正在运行的终端会被关闭。随 Pi Desktop 分发。
